narrative.overview:
Gestão Escolar is where secretaria, finance, teachers and coordination spend whole working days. The interface recedes: a pale gray floor, white panels that hold the data, one blue for action, and color otherwise reserved for state. Nothing decorative competes with a student's name, a balance or a grade. If a screen draws attention to itself, it is too loud.

It is built on Flowbite React's light theme over Tailwind 4, used close to stock. Its craft is restraint and consistency: every list looks like every other list, every form like every other form, so someone who learned one screen has learned them all. Density is medium-high: 14px body text, 10px cell padding, tabular numerals wherever numbers stack.

The product serves Único Educacional today and other schools later. The school's logo and name are tenant content shown in the sidebar, login and letterhead. They never tint the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Light only: `color-scheme: light`; `dark:` utilities exist but nothing activates them.
One action color (blue), one typeface (Geist), one radius (8px).
Color carries state: green active/paid, red overdue/below passing, amber pending/recovery, gray neutral.
White data panels with a soft drop shadow, floating on a gray-50 floor.
Desktop-first density; lists reflow to stacked rows on phones.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "you can act here" (buttons, focus, the caret, the row being edited). It is never a decorative accent or a section color.

rules.name: The Tenant Color Rule
rules.body: The school's brand colors (Único's red logo) appear only in the school's own logo and letterhead, never in buttons, nav or highlights. Another school must be able to drop in its logo without the UI clashing.

rules.name: The State Earns Color Rule
rules.body: Green, red and amber are reserved for the state of a record. A row is red because it is overdue or below passing, never for emphasis.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any column or input of grades, money, dates or CPF uses `tabular-nums` so digits line up.

rules.name: The pt-BR Rule
rules.body: Everything shown is Brazilian Portuguese: comma decimals (2,50), R$ with a thousands dot, dd/mm/aaaa dates, formatted CPF/CEP.

rules.name: The Soft Panel Rule
rules.body: Data lives on a white panel with the panel-lift shadow, never on a bordered box or a nested card. Inside a panel, separate groups with hairline dividers, not more shadows.

dos: **Do** keep one primary (blue) button per view; everything else uses the alternative button.
**Do** put data in the white panel with the panel-lift shadow, using `<ListPage>` / `<ListRow>` for lists.
**Do** use `tabular-nums` and right alignment for grades, money and counts.
**Do** use state color only for record state (paid, overdue, below passing, recovery).
**Do** reuse Flowbite components and the house wrappers (`<FormFields>`, `TextField`, `<LinkButton>`, `<DeleteButton>`) before writing new markup.
**Do** design lists to reflow into stacked rows below `sm`, and keep quick classroom tasks usable one-handed on a phone.
donts: **Don't** bring the school's logo colors (Único red) into buttons, nav, or highlights.
**Don't** add a second accent color, gradients, or decorative illustrations.
**Don't** wrap data in bordered boxes or nested cards; use the soft panel.
**Don't** add dark-mode-only styling expecting it to show: the app is light only.
**Don't** use red, green or amber for emphasis unrelated to a record's state.
